text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Fan Fest has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is competing in one of the
festival's
main events—the carrot
bread-eating race.
However...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-there are so many people here. They
must all
be... our fans...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Trainer, help! Wh-what should I
do?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The pressure to not disappoint my fans...
It's... It's
making my heart beat out of my
chest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to think of some way to calm her
nerves,
when...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's the runner from the Kikuka Sho! I
watched
you race on TV! You were so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Uhhh, are you talking about
me?!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be just like you when I grow up!
Teehee!
Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And... off she goes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that takes me back. I wonder if I
was like
that when I was little too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to race like the Umamusume I
saw on
TV... That's when I started
dreaming of becoming
the best in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right! Now it's my time to
inspire
children to dream.
choice_data_list_en: It's your turn this time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, Trainer! Off I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Special Week shakes off
her nerves
and steps up to join the
carrot bread-eating race.
As for the
results...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww... I lost!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
While I was running, I thought I had a
chance to
win, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really blew it, huh? I really wanted to look cool in front of that kid.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list_en: Time for revenge at the Tenno Sho!
Time to get your revenge at the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'll make sure I don't let my fans
down
next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's defeat at the Fan Fest
appears to
inspire her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won! First place! I did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
While I was running, I was like, "I think I
got this!"
And then... I did! I think I
figured out a new
running technique!

text_block_list.name: Chairman (Akikawa)
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! I must say, you put on a great
show today,
Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Director?! Wh-what are you
doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Chairman (Akikawa)
text_block_list.text: Hah! I'm here to reward you...

text_block_list.name: Chairman (Akikawa)
text_block_list.text: Just listen to those cheers!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, you were amazing! I'll be
cheering
you on like crazy in the future!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Good luck at the Tenno Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Chairman (Akikawa)
text_block_list.text: Keep up the great work! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! Thanks so much,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll work even harder to
become the top
Umamusume in all of
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's performance at the Fan
Fest has
led to a burst of motivation.
